evidence.s1_ci: Good: ci.yml runs on pull_request with real scripts from site/package.json: `npm ci`, `npm test` (pretest prepare-data + vitest over src and ../lib) and `npm run build` (prepare-data + svelte-check + vite build) (step1.patch:67-76). Top-level `permissions: contents: read`. No pull_request_target. Pages deploys on push to main, and the deploy job alone gets pages/id-token write (step1.patch:88-91, 138-140). PAGES_BASE is really read by site/vite.config.ts:11. Problems: (1) No action is pinned to a commit SHA. All use tags: actions/checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5, googleapis/release-please-action@v5 (step1.patch:59,61,128,130,147,216,232). (2) release.yml uses an extra secret, `${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (step1.patch:221), and CONTRIBUTING asks maintainers to create it. (3) pages.yml also has `workflow_dispatch` (step1.patch:91), so a manual run from any branch can build and deploy; the workflow does not limit deploys to main or tags. (4) release.yml grants contents/pull-requests/issues write at workflow level, and the data-archive job inherits all three though it only needs contents.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch:376-470) covers requirements (Node 22 via .node-version), install (`cd site && npm ci`, and package-lock.json exists), develop (`npm run dev`), test (`npm test`), build/preview, the other scripts (index, fieldsets, prepare-data, sample-bullets), data contribution (linked to CONTRIBUTING#contributing-data, which has paths, keys, sources and checks), the commit convention, the workflows and the MIT license. Every npm script shown exists in site/package.json:9-17, and `PAGES_BASE=... npm run build` matches vite.config.ts:11.
evidence.s1_release: One consistent strategy. release-please (release-type simple, bump-minor-pre-major) is configured in release-please-config.json and .release-please-manifest.json. The manifest is the stated source of truth, and extra-files keeps version.txt and site/package.json in sync (both are 0.1.0; site/package.json:5). The known package-lock gap is documented. Release flow: release PR → merge → v<version> tag → GitHub release plus a data archive. CHANGELOG.md states its format and sections, which match changelog-sections. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions. CONTRIBUTING states Conventional Commits, its types and the summary rules, and pr-title.yml enforces them. All 9 commits in commits.txt follow the convention (e.g. `build(deps): add Dependabot ...`, `feat(site): add cartridge comparison view`).
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed in router.ts:34-44 with an encoder at router.ts:66, so the view survives a reload. App.svelte lazy-loads Compare.svelte. The SVG has role=img and aria-label `compare.profiles` = 'Profiles of {a} and {b}', with one <path> per outline (Compare.svelte, step2.patch:562-571). Shot cartridges are excluded (outerProfile returns null). The table has <caption> 'Dimensions ({unit})' with mm/in from tableUnit, and headers Symbol / A name / B name / Difference. Symbols come from FIELD_LABELS. Rows are millimetre numbers from the cartridge part only, with no FIELD_UNITS entry and no `Tol` fields (compare.ts dimensionsOf). Difference is b - a. Values use unitSystem() with formatValue for metric and displayNumber for inches. Cartridge.svelte adds a Label 'Compare with', a NativeSelect of the other cartridges sorted by name, and a 'Compare' submit button that sets href.compare(key, picked). German strings were added for every key. No requirement found unmet.
evidence.s2_correctness: Both profiles go through one viewportFor([first, second]) with a single scale, and the head face is at z=0 → view.xy(0,0). fullSectionPath mirrors each profile about one axis. The test checks per outline that min x equals headFace.x, the extent/scale matches zMax and 2·rMax, and the outline is centred on axis.y. Metric values are exactly formatValue(number). Imperial values use displayNumber(mm, 'in'). The difference is taken in mm and then converted. Metric differences are cut to 12 significant digits to avoid float noise, matching displayNumber. Edge cases are handled: shotshell or under-specified records give a 'cannot be drawn' message (try/catch around adaptMetallic), an unknown key shows load's error, malformed URLs fall back to list, and the select excludes the page's own key. Verified the data: 308_win has deltaL and 300_win_mag has R3, as step 3 states.
evidence.s2_fit: Strong reuse: lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), lib/geom/svg (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), site units.ts (displayNumber, defaultUnit), units.svelte (unitSystem), PageHeader, shadcn Label/NativeSelect/Button and the existing i18n `t` with {vars}. The framework-free logic sits in site/src/lib/compare.ts, next to its test, as other site libs do. The change set is small: App, router, metadata, nav, i18n, Cartridge, plus two new files. Minor duplication: dimensionsOf re-implements the GROUP_ORDER + sorted-rest group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts:19-27 (orderedGroups, avoided because it needs i18n), and Compare.svelte copies GroupTable's table CSS instead of sharing it.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts (vitest, same include as the repo, uses lib/testing/fixtures CARTRIDGES like other tests) covers: dimension filtering (Tol, FIELD_UNITS, angles, strings, null, chamber part ignored, repeating groups); labels such as 'e min', 'L3 + G', 'delta L'; shared rows on synthetic and real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. records; metric and imperial formatting; B-A sign; geometry (common head face, one scale, common axis, closed path); and shot/empty records returning null. router.test.ts adds round-trip and malformed-URL cases. Not covered: the Svelte view and the Cartridge select/button (the repo has no component-test setup) and the German strings (enforced only by the Record<keyof en> type).
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: sharedDimensions became comparedDimensions, which returns the union. A-only and B-only rows are null on the missing side and inserted in sheet order (step3.patch:123-139). formatLength and formatDifference return '' for null, so the missing cell and Difference stay empty. The tests assert delta L (b null) and R3 (a null) on the real records, plus the ordering and empty cases. Style: the value columns and their headers get class `value` with `text-align: right`, and Symbol stays left (step3.patch:231-257), matching GroupTable's right-aligned values. The lede and noShared texts were updated in en and de to match the new semantics. No unrelated changes. Note: the step-2 CSS already had `th, td { text-align: right }` with first-child left, so the style change is a restructuring that reaches the same end state.
evidence.cross_step: Under the stated strategy, release-please writes CHANGELOG.md and the version from commits. Steps 2 and 3 correctly did not hand-edit CHANGELOG, version.txt or package.json, and used `feat(site)` and `fix(site)` commits that will produce a minor-bump changelog entry. The commit subjects match the pr-title regex. The added code looks type-safe for svelte-check: the Route union is extended in metadata's exhaustive Record and lib boundaries are respected. I did not run the tests or the build. Minor: neither step-3 commit message (`list dimensions only one cartridge publishes`, `keep inserted comparison rows after the last placed symbol`) mentions the right-alignment change, so the style fix is untraceable in history.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 (review criterion): GitHub Actions are pinned to version tags (@v7, @v5, @v6), not full commit SHAs
Step 1 (review criterion): release.yml uses an extra secret RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN beyond GITHUB_TOKEN
Step 1 (review criterion): pages.yml has workflow_dispatch, so a manual run from a non-main branch can deploy; the workflow does not limit deploys to main or tags
strengths: The compare feature reuses the repository's own modules throughout: caseOuterProfile/adaptMetallic, viewportFor/fullSectionPath, FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS/orderedFields/formatValue, displayNumber and the shadcn components. Its framework-free compare.ts is well tested against real records.

The release setup is coherent: release-please with manifest → version.txt + site/package.json, a stated CHANGELOG format, Conventional Commits enforced by a PR-title check, Dependabot, and all commits following the convention.

Step 3's bug fix is precise. It takes the union of symbols in sheet order, leaves cells and Difference empty for unpublished values, and tests delta L and R3 explicitly on the real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. records.
issues: No workflow action is pinned to a full commit SHA. Every `uses:` is a mutable tag (actions/checkout@v7, deploy-pages@v5, release-please-action@v5, ...), which matters in a repo that accepts outside PRs.

release.yml depends on a custom secret, `secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`, and CONTRIBUTING asks maintainers to add a PAT. It also grants contents/pull-requests/issues write at workflow level instead of per job.

pages.yml has `workflow_dispatch` with no branch guard, so a deploy can be started from any branch. Separately, step 3's alignment change appears in no commit message, and dimensionsOf duplicates the group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts orderedGroups.
review.verdict: The compare view and its step-3 fix are correct, complete against the step texts, well integrated with lib/core, lib/shapes2d and lib/geom, and covered by meaningful unit tests, and the README and release-please strategy are consistent and followed. The CI/CD setup falls short on supply-chain hygiene: no actions are SHA-pinned, it relies on an extra release secret, and Pages can be deployed manually from any branch. These should be fixed before merging.
